text: TDK Corporation's shares are traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Its principal shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) with 27.01% and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account) with 11.73%; the Government of Norway held 1.29%.
short: TDK is listed in Tokyo; its largest shareholders are trust accounts of Japanese trust banks.
